##### Project general facts

The Diplomat Residences by NSHAMA is built on a lovely idea: that your home is alive and vital, and that every square inch of it should reflect your personality. Aesthetic and functional in equal measure, the building offers a choice of intuitive floor plans that let you accent and define your home exactly the way you want it. Studios, one, two and three bedroom apartments give you the versatility to create a place you can truly call your own, with every design, from the individual units to the complex as a whole, planned to perfection for the modern homebuyer.

Residents are welcomed by a bright, beautifully appointed lobby with a reception and comfortable seating, setting a calm and gracious tone from the very first step. At the heart of the building lies a gorgeous swimming pool in the courtyard, framed by a generous sun deck, shaded loungers and a dedicated play area where children can enjoy themselves in full view. A convenient shopping podium within the building, along with a fitness area and all the amenities one would expect from a world-class residential address, keeps wellness, entertainment and everyday leisure just a step away.

Inside, the living and dining areas are filled with abundant natural light, creating spaces that feel open, airy and effortlessly elegant. Bedrooms are furnished with glazed porcelain floors and in-built wardrobes, while master bedrooms enjoy the added comfort of their own en-suite bathroom. The modern day kitchen layouts are just as thoughtful, with scratch and stain proof prep counters, generous overhead cabinets and glazed porcelain tile flooring that is as practical as it is handsome.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a vibrant and expansive mega-development located in the heart of Dubai. At the core of Town Square Dubai is the picturesque Town Square Park, which serves as the central hub for residents and visitors alike. The park features lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas, providing a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and creating a sense of unity and community spirit.

Town Square Dubai boasts a host of exceptional facilities and amenities, making it a vibrant and dynamic place to live. Residents can enjoy access to sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, as well as retail and dining outlets within the community. A Town Square Mall, with a variety of shops and entertainment options, further enriches the living experience.

The development's strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, Town Square Dubai is within proximity to schools, hospitals, and other essential services, offering residents a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.
